headline: Two cocktails hurled outside PM’s Office in Dhaka
summary: Two motorcycle-borne attackers threw crude bombs in front of the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon late Friday night.
details: Two motorcycle-borne attackers threw crude bombs in front of the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, Dhaka, late Friday night.
The incident occurred around 1:15 AM on October 9. One cocktail exploded, while another remained unexploded.
Police recovered the unexploded device and the bomb disposal unit neutralized it around 2:30 AM.
No casualties were reported in the attack.
Police are currently working to identify and arrest the suspects who fled the scene.
Security has been tightened around the Prime Minister's Office, and traffic control measures have been implemented.
caption:
Two crude bombs thrown outside the Prime Minister's Office in Dhaka late Friday night.

Two motorcycle-borne attackers threw crude bombs in front of the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, Dhaka, late Friday night.

The incident occurred around 1:15 AM on October 9. One cocktail exploded, while another remained unexploded.

Police recovered the unexploded device and the bomb disposal unit neutralized it around 2:30 AM.

No casualties were reported in the attack.

Police are currently working to identify and arrest the suspects who fled the scene.

Security has been tightened around the Prime Minister's Office, and traffic control measures have been implemented.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #Security #BreakingNews #PMO

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee detained in Gurugram ahead of Delhi protest
summary: The Germany-based influencer was taken into custody at his residence after refusing police requests not to travel to Jantar Mantar for a CJP-led demonstration.
details: Germany-based YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained at his residence in Gurugram on Saturday morning. He had recently travelled to India to participate in a planned protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.
caption:
YouTuber Dhruv Rathee detained at home before he could even reach the protest site.

Germany-based YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained at his residence in Gurugram on Saturday morning. He had recently travelled to India to participate in a planned protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.
